paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е кръгова диаграма, сравняваща различни категории персонажи. Общият брой на категориите е 13, разделени на три основни групи: Виртуални персонажи, Персонализирани персонажи и Реални персонажи. Виртуалните персонажи са представени в светлосин цвят и представляват приблизително 60% от диаграмата, и се подразбират на Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters и Game Characters, като Movie Characters са най-големият подсегмент. Презентацията на Реалните персонажи е в бледорозов цвят и съдържа седем подкатегории: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors и Influencers, с Musicians като най-големият сегмент. Custom Characters са представени в светлозелено и заемат малък дял от цялостната диаграма, без допълнителни обозначени подкатегории. Диаграмата включва легенда, но не съдържа етикети с проценти върху отделните сектори. Няма визуално подчертани сегменти. Наблюдава се визуално подреждане на сегментите във всяка основна група, в низходящ ред по размер.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of character types within the RoleplayPref dataset. The chart is divided into 13 segments, representing broad categories and subcategories of characters. The largest segment, Virtual Characters, occupies roughly 60% of the chart and is further divided into Comic Characters (blue), Movie Characters (light blue), Teleplay Characters (teal), Novel Characters (dark blue), and Game Characters (turquoise). The Real Characters category, represented in green, comprises seven subcategories: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers. Custom Characters, depicted in a pale green hue, represent a smaller portion of the overall distribution, without any further subcategories. The chart includes a legend, and all segments appear organized in a descending order of size, with Virtual Characters being the largest.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Kreisdiagramm zeigt die Verteilung von Charakteren in RoleplayPref, die in drei Hauptkategorien unterteilt sind: Virtuelle Charaktere, benutzerdefinierte Charaktere und reale Charaktere, mit 13 Unterkategorien im äußeren Ring. Insgesamt gibt es 16 Segmente im Diagramm. Virtuelle Charaktere machen etwa 60 % der Verteilung aus und sind in Comic-Charaktere (blau), Filmcharaktere (hellblau), Teleplay-Charaktere (hellblau), Romancharaktere (blau) und Spielcharaktere (blau) unterteilt, wobei Filmcharaktere die größte Unterkategorie innerhalb virtueller Charaktere darstellen. Reale Charaktere machen etwa 30 % der Verteilung aus und umfassen die Unterkategorien Wissenschaftler, Künstler, Sportler, Autoren, Musiker, Schauspieler und Influencer (alle in Grün), wobei Musiker das größte Segment innerhalb der realen Charaktere darstellen. Benutzerdefinierte Charaktere machen den verbleibenden Anteil von etwa 10 % aus und haben keine beschrifteten Unterkategorien. Das Diagramm enthält eine Legende, die die einzelnen Kategorien und Unterkategorien identifiziert, und die Segmente sind in einer kreisförmigen Anordnung angeordnet.
